correctness.rationale: The nine explicit 20-symbol Pauli generators have independent rank 9 and commute; all 512 stabilizers have nonzero weight at least 12. For |E|=4 the local logical quotient has dimension 8-rank(H_E). Fresh Python independently formed the 40-bit symplectic rows, enumerated all 4845 four-subsets and computed the exact dimension counts 3840, 970, 35; all 35 rank-six local subspaces are isotropic. Four-erasure failure count is 1005; <=3 are correctable by distance 4, >=5 are uncorrectable since 2|E|>=10 exceeds nine commutation constraints and no stabilizer fits in a five-set. Thus P_succ(p)=sum_{j=0}^{3} binom(20,j)p^j(1-p)^(20-j)+3840 p^4(1-p)^16, 0<=p<=1.
